protocol: 1080p diffuse direct only; cube sampling, old weights, no visibility, RC, ReSTIR, denoising or TAA. 256 warmup, one single frame and 32-frame mean/variance in eight batches. Common complete-pixel mask; missing samples are reported. Variance is not reference MSE. Profiling uses 128 warmup and 128 measured frames, palindrome order, two runs per case; tree sum is the sum of average times for prepare6 through prepare19. Unrelated duplicate pass metrics have conflicts; all reported metrics are checked conflict-free.

mapping.scope: CPU execution of actual integer GLSL body; not Iris/GPU validation
